daily_narrative.happened: US equities finished mixed but calm on the surface, with small-cap outperformance, a jump in VIX, and sharp declines in several software names; the move appears to reflect a rotation out of high-multiple technology and into more cyclical/defensive pockets, with AI/semi strength visible in CRDO, INTC, MU, and ONTO. In a Goldilocks regime, the combination of value and momentum leadership, plus strength in Health Care and Industrials, suggests investors are favoring earnings durability over long-duration growth after the week’s tech-led drawdown.
